messages:
maria hsiao: starting a thread to track the new 'Frag Guardian' set of mitigations after the cluster OOMs this morning. tagging owners and timelines here as canonical.

kevin nguyen: saw the same. heap profiles point at repeated small allocations in the cache insert path; jemalloc arena fragmentation high.

samir patel: ops-bot created incident 1991234567-kv-frag-guardian. Priority P1. link: https://incidents.redwood/1991234567

ops-bot: Incident 1991234567 opened and assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

maria hsiao: immediate (Fast) actions I suggest:
- F1: soft per-shard memory guard for kv-cache to trigger throttled evictions (owner: kevin) - ETA 18h
- F2: temporary eviction bias against entries >128KB (owner: avi) - ETA 6h
- F3: continuous heap sampling + jemalloc stats at 20s resolution for 72h (owner: samir) - ETA 1h
- F4: add PagerDuty alarm for sustained cache growth (>6% in 10m) with GC pressure tag (owner: maria) - ETA 3h

avi nguyen: (typo) kevin nguyen: implementing F1 as a soft ceiling so we avoid crash loops. plan is throttled evictions with telemetry: evictions/sec, miss-rate, p95 latency. canary rollout 1% -> 5% -> 20%.

avi (correction) avi singh: I'll open the quick PR for F2 and scope it to a feature flag. adding unit and integration tests to simulate large-entry churn. PR #5012.

samir patel: starting the 20s heap sampling now and forwarding traces to s3://oom-traces/1991234567/. also scheduling a staging compaction benchmark to measure GC cost vs fragmentation gain.

maria hsiao: short checklist for owners: please post a one-line update here when you hit the ETA or if blocked. I'll keep the follow-up doc updated: https://docs.redwood/eng-runtime/frag-guardian-followups

kevin nguyen: first profiler snippet (pprof top) for context:
```
# pprof --text kv-cache.heap.2026-03-24.pb
  38.9%  38.9%  runtime.mallocgc
  25.7%  64.6%  github.com/redwood/kv.(*Cache).insert
  12.4%  77.0%  github.com/redwood/kv.serializeKey
```

navi (avi) avi singh: quick reproducible load I'm using on staging to stress fragmentation:
```
for i in $(seq 1 30000); do
  size=$(( (i % 8 + 1) * 32 * 1024 ))
  http POST https://staging-kv/set k=$i v=@<(head -c $size /dev/urandom)
done
```

kevin nguyen: F1 prototype branch open, includes telemetry panels and guard flags. will enable 1% canary after tests.

samir patel: staging compaction benchmark initial run: fragmentation index dropped 0.50 -> 0.33, CPU +3.5%. sharing dashboard: /dash/kv/frag-guardian-bench

maria hsiao: important: we've seen this class of OOMs recur over last 2 months with slightly different triggers (ghost allocs, large payload spikes, slow compaction). tagging incident as recurring-class:kv-fragmentation. we'll treat LT backlog items as program-level work.

kevin nguyen: Long-term (Program) items to track under Frag Guardian backlog:
- P1: slab allocator / pooled arenas for hot size-classes (owners: samir + kevin) - ETA 6w
- P2: zero-copy path for values >64KB to avoid memcpy churn (owner: avi) - ETA 3w
- P3: background compaction service with runtime knobs (owner: samir) - ETA 4w
- P4: synthetic CI job reproducing fragmentation pattern and weekly run (owner: avi) - ETA 2w

avi (avi) avi singh: I'll take P2 and P4. P2 spike will include benchmarks and safety gates for rollout.

samir patel: P3 prototype shows promise; will flesh out scheduling policy to avoid CPU spikes during traffic peaks.

maria hsiao: tracking matrix in the follow-up doc will include owner, ETA, PR link, canary scope, and business impact note. I'll schedule a 30-minute retro in 7 days and a program sync weekly until P1 is complete.

kevin nguyen: F1 canary enabled at 00:40 UTC to 1% on a small set of shards. monitoring memory, miss-rate, and p95. initial 45m look stable.

avi avi singh: F2 PR #5012 merged to canary; enabling at 2% now. will watch eviction spike and p95.

samir patel: continuous samplers live and first wave of profiles uploaded. starting automated diff job to compare heap shapes over time.

maria hsiao: good progress. please post short notes as you hit milestones. one thing to watch: eviction of large entries may raise application-level latency for some clients; please coordinate with support if we see customer impact.

kevin nguyen: note on fallback: if eviction causes unacceptable miss penalties, runtime routing has fallback-> warmed-replica flag we can enable per-route (config routing.kv.fallback.warmed=true). I'll add a dashboard that correlates miss-rate to client p95.

avi avi singh: EOD canary update: 2% traffic stable for 90m, eviction rate within expected bounds, small p95 blip early then normalized. pushing to 20% tomorrow.

samir patel: staging compaction extended run (2h) still shows frag index improvement with steady CPU overhead ~+3.2%. saving logs and traces to s3.

maria hsiao: summary for the canonical follow-up doc: F1(kevin,18h), F2(avi,6h), F3(samir,1h), F4(maria,3h); P1(samir+kevin,6w), P2(avi,3w), P3(samir,4w), P4(avi,2w). retro scheduled in 7 days; weekly program sync every Monday. recurring-class tag added: kv-fragmentation. :white_check_mark:

kevin nguyen: locking this thread as the action tracker for Frag Guardian. will post the 24h canary dump once available.

avi avi singh: will upload CI repro artifacts and PR links when ready.

samir patel: setting a recurring calendar event 'frag-guardian-sync' and adding initial perf findings to the follow-up doc.

maria hsiao: closing this Slack thread for now; reopening if new OOMs or canary regression. thanks everyone.
